app: AI-Weld Settings Library / Vectis Weld Recipe Control
purpose: Create controlled mild steel starter data records for testing without treating them as tested, approved, locked, recommended, or production-ready recipes.

status_rules.starter_data_library_rule: Starter data must not appear as locked recipe data.
status_rules.approval_rule: Starter data must be tested through a test coupon and approved before any locked recipe can be created.
status_rules.recommendation_rule: Starter rows are not best, ideal, or recommended settings. They are controlled reference inputs for future testing only.
